list.name: Telemetry Events
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry_events")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.name)

options.content: Telemetry event ranges (`telemetry_events` in Influx). Copy the **Telemetry Events** annotation layer to telemetry dashboards.
